  "The filter has an off/bypass mode selectable through the parameter system and GUI that passes the voice signal through unchanged (bit-exact), defaulting to off.",
  "The causes of the globally filtered/dirty/resonant character are identified with external references and reproducible measurements, and reported as named mechanisms with evidence.",
  "Fixes stay within phase 1-3 scope and any change to already-working behavior (default filter state, gain staging, limiter) is discussed with the owner before it is applied.",
  "Unit tests cover the bypass mode and the corrected default behavior; the full suite stays green and the code still builds."
]
